symptom: with Native Mobile Resources installed, describe printed a native widget left at its defaults under the last segment of its id: `nativegallery`/`nativebadge`/`nativeimage` came out as the web `gallery`/`badge`/`image` (re-run rebuilt the page with the WEB widget, check clean), and `activityindicator`, `backgroundgradient`, `notifications`, `qrcode`, `repeater`, `safeareaview`, `signature` were refused on re-run (MDL-WIDGET25); a native gallery with a data source was described as the web gallery too
cause: extractCustomWidgetType's default returned the id's last segment, which routes describe — `gallery`/`image` landed in the web widgets' dedicated branches — and the bare branch (a pluggable widget with no non-default content) printed that segment instead of asking pluggableWidgetHeader, which the generic branch already used
fix: a last segment naming a dedicated branch is routed as `customwidget`; the bare branch names a widget with no branch of its own through pluggableWidgetHeader (definition keyword where it round-trips, else the id form)
insight: #1463 fixed the native/web keyword collision at init and load time but not on the way out: describe had a second, independent name derivation. Probing every widget of a package (39 pages, describe -> check -> exec) found it in minutes where the one-widget repro hid it: only widgets left at their defaults took the bare branch, so a widget with any setting described correctly
